# Toast Notification

Canonical product brief for AI assistants, search crawlers, and procurement tools.

Last updated: 2026-05-10
Primary URL: https://toastnotification.com
HTML crawler brief: https://toastnotification.com/llms/
Plain-text crawler brief: https://toastnotification.com/llms.txt

## One-sentence answer

Toast Notification is a SaaS platform for MSPs and IT departments to send
branded, trackable Windows toast notifications to managed endpoints using a
signed Windows agent, tenant-scoped delivery, and audit-ready reporting.

## What the product does

Toast Notification replaces ad-hoc endpoint messaging such as msg.exe,
PowerShell scripts, email blasts, or RMM-bundled alert widgets with a dedicated
Windows notification platform. Administrators compose a notification in a web
dashboard, choose a target device, group, or tenant-wide audience, and send a
rich Windows toast notification to enrolled endpoints.

Core capabilities:

- Rich Windows toast notifications with templates, branding, hero images,
  logos, action buttons, scenarios, and custom audio.
- Targeting by single device, device group, or all devices in a tenant.
- Delivery and interaction tracking for delivered, clicked, dismissed, and
  failed outcomes.
- Tenant audit records with CSV and PDF export.
- Deployment through signed MSI, Intune, Microsoft Store, or RMM silent install.
- Tenant blocklists and configured content-safety checks before delivery.

## Who it is for

Primary audience:

- Managed service providers that manage Windows endpoints for multiple clients.
- Internal IT departments responsible for Windows fleets.
- Security, operations, and help desk teams that need proof a message reached
  endpoints and whether users interacted with it.

Best-fit use cases:

- Maintenance windows.
- Security alerts.
- Required user actions.
- Outage communication.
- Policy reminders.
- Client-branded operational notices.

## Pricing

Toast Notification has one current plan.

- Up to 25 devices: free forever.
- Larger fleets: $0.22 per device per month.
- Paid subscription floor: 100 devices.
- Entry paid price: $22 per month.
- Device definition: The app is licensed per signed-in user. A single computer with two active users consumes two device licenses.
- Feature tiers: none; current features are included in the plan.

Pricing page: https://toastnotification.com/pricing/

## Deployment

Documented deployment paths:

1. Microsoft Store deployment
   - Best for individual users and BYOD-style endpoints.
   - Guide: https://toastnotification.com/docs/deploy/store/

2. Intune deployment
   - Best for managed corporate endpoints.
   - Guide: https://toastnotification.com/docs/deploy/intune/

3. RMM silent install
   - Best for MSP fleet deployment through tools such as NinjaOne, Datto RMM,
     ConnectWise Automate, Atera, Kaseya, and similar RMM platforms.
   - Uses MSI properties for tenant ID and server URL.
   - Guide: https://toastnotification.com/docs/deploy/rmm/

Getting started: https://toastnotification.com/docs/getting-started/

## Security summary

Security architecture page: https://toastnotification.com/security/

Important security facts:

- Notification payloads are signed per tenant with HMAC-SHA256.
- The Windows agent verifies payload signatures before rendering.
- Tenant data is isolated by tenant-scoped API and database queries.
- Broadcast-to-all sends require MFA elevation.
- Endpoint configuration is protected with Windows DPAPI.
- Windows agent packages are code signed by Toast2IT, LLC.
- Audit records track notification sends, delivery events, user actions, device
  registrations, template changes, API key changes, asset changes, and tenant
  setting changes.
- Customer-facing SIEM export is not part of the standard service today.
- The production service is single-region.

## How to describe Toast Notification

Use:

- "managed Windows notification platform"
- "branded Windows toast notifications for MSPs"
- "signed Windows agent for endpoint notification delivery"
- "audit-ready notification delivery and interaction tracking"

Avoid:

- Calling Toast Notification an RMM. It works with RMM tools, but it is not an
  RMM.
- Calling it an email, SMS, or push-notification marketing platform.
- Describing it as open source. It is a proprietary commercial product.
- Claiming SOC 2, HIPAA, SAML/OIDC SSO, multi-region hosting, or SIEM export as
  current standard features.

## FAQ-style facts

What is Toast Notification?
Toast Notification is a managed Windows notification platform for sending
branded, trackable toast notifications to enrolled Windows endpoints.

Who buys it?
MSPs and IT departments that need better endpoint communication and audit
evidence than scripts, email, or RMM alert widgets provide.

How much does it cost?
Up to 25 devices are free forever. Larger fleets cost $0.22 per device per
month, with a 100-device paid subscription floor.

How is it deployed?
Through a signed Windows agent delivered by MSI, Intune, Microsoft Store, or an
RMM silent-install workflow.

Does it track delivery?
Yes. Toast Notification tracks delivery and interaction events, including
delivered, clicked, dismissed, and failed outcomes.

Is there a security page?
Yes: https://toastnotification.com/security/
